stances.quote: Selfridge is a critical asset to our national security and a major contributor to Michigan's economy. ... I will always work with my Michigan colleagues to bring critical funding like this to the state to improve our economy and keep our country safe
stances.reasoning: Text supports increased military-related funding for bases and national security assets.

stances.quote: As a father of six, I understand the importance of every dollar in raising a family. That is why I supported tax reform that will let hardworking Michigan families keep more of their own money.
stances.reasoning: Explicit support for tax cuts and extending 2017 tax reform to lower taxes.

stances.quote: Excessive spending in Washington has been unchecked for too long, and as a result, our nation faces over $30 trillion in debt. Plain and simple, our obligations are growing faster than our ability to pay them. We must find a way to get the federal government's spending under control
stances.reasoning: Repeated calls for reduced federal spending and fiscal responsibility to control debt.
